weights: unchanged old matched mixed-L proxy models
selection: Descriptive: tune on already-observed test-query Recall, freeze, independently retime SAME queries. NOT held-out generalization.
targets: native L100 and native L160 for 1M / L500 for SIFT100M
exact: equal integer total_hits / 10000; no interpolation, no mixed policies, no output truncation
search: existing grid first; then two larger L: ceil(1.5*referenceL), 2*referenceL; 12 bounded scalar bisection evaluations per L, plus up to 8 local probes per family/target; nonmonotonicity possible; no guarantee exact feasible
selection_objective: exact and active preferred, then absolute hit gap, then measured P95; inactive exact shown separately
active: Heuristic/Ours: skips>0; ET: stopped fraction>0; Joint: skips>0 AND stopped fraction>0
controls: same binary/index/model/query/K10/beam4/threads4/cache10000/warm128 as original; Linux/Reader/4096 equality and zero swap checks inherited
budget: at most32 NEW probes per family/target; 2 targets x8 families x3 datasets; old grid reused read-only
